name: Suzhou Silk Scarf
where: Suzhou Silk Museum shop or Qian Tai Xiang
about: A scarf made from Suzhou silk, a textile the city has been known for over many centuries. It is a classic gift that connects you to the local silk trade.
tip: Check the label for 100% silk before you buy.

name: Su Embroidery Small Frame
where: Su Embroidery Studio, Baodai West Road (book in advance)
about: Su embroidery is a traditional Suzhou craft known for fine, detailed stitching. A small framed piece shows this skill in a compact form.
tip: Confirm it is hand-embroidered, check the size, and ask whether it is double-sided.

name: Suzhou Folding Fan
about: A traditional folding fan associated with Suzhou craftsmanship. It is a light, easy-to-carry souvenir with a long local history.
tip: Check whether the frame is bamboo and what material the fan face is made of.
